releaseNotes: Nokiatis MUC 1.17.0-beta.1 — the app now asks, once, on first open: sign in to Nokiatis Cloud to save your data across phones (everything syncs automatically from that moment), or continue as a guest and know the cost: guest data stays on this phone only and is lost if the app or its data is deleted. Share links for songs and playlists now travel in full Arabic. This is a BETA: it never locks the app and can always be skipped.
